name: Google Developer Groups (GDG)
shortDescription: A Google-powered community for student developers exploring ML, competitive programming, and open source.
fullDescription: GDG On Campus is a global community of developers that's powered by Google, and driven by innovation. At GDG RVCE, we bring together passionate student developers through thriving focus areas such as Machine Learning, Competitive Programming, and Open-Source. Through workshops, projects, hackathons, tech-discussions, study jams, and seminars, we empower our members to create, collaborate, and connect with a worldwide network of tech enthusiasts, and build what truly matters.
events: The Ultimate Google-Powered Coding Starter Kit; Money Heist: Grand Larceny; Bite-Sized Machine Learning for Absolute Beginners; Google Your Way to Hackathon Victory

name: Project Jatayu
shortDescription: A student-led team building Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) for real-world surveillance, reconnaissance, and agriculture challenges.
fullDescription: Project Jatayu, founded in 2009, is one of India's top student led teams shaping the future of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). From our debut at the Australian Outback Challenge to competing on the global stage at the AUVSI's SUAS, we've grown into a powerhouse of innovation. Bringing together talent from Aerospace, Mechanical, Electronics, and Computer Science, we design drones that merge precision engineering with creative vision. Our UAVs take on real world challenges in surveillance, reconnaissance, and agriculture, offering opportunities for innovators from every branch of engineering.
events: Drone Assembly; Drone101; Drone Simulation; Game of Drones

name: Coding Club RVCE
shortDescription: A vibrant community for passionate coders focused on programming, problem-solving, and innovation.
fullDescription: The Coding Club of RVCE is a vibrant community for passionate coders, fostering skills in programming, problem-solving, and innovation. We organize campus-wide coding competitions, technical workshops, and collaborative projects in areas like web development, ML, and Web3. Members engage in open-source contributions, represent the college at prestigious contests, and gain insights from alumni sessions. We aim to inspire creativity, sharpen technical expertise, and build a strong coding culture on campus.
events: Fresher's Frontier; Cache Me If You Can; Horcrux Hunt CTF; AI Odyssey

name: RV QuizCorp
shortDescription: RVCE's quizzing club, running national-level quizzes across topics like history, sports, entertainment, and science.
fullDescription: RV QuizCorp is the quizzing club of RVCE, founded in 1998. RV QuizCorp has grown into one of the best known clubs in national quizzing circuits and has gained nationwide recognition for both winning and organizing quizzes of the highest standard. To promote quizzing culture in RVCE and for the sheer thrill of quizzing, we also organize quizzes on topics as varied as science-tech, sports, entertainment and politics.
events: The India Quiz; The Entertainment Quiz; The Sports Quiz; The Science Business Tech Quiz

name: Project Garuda
shortDescription: RVCE's official super mileage vehicle team, designing ultra fuel-efficient cars for competitions like the Shell Eco-Marathon.
fullDescription: Project Garuda is the official super mileage student team of RV College of Engineering (RVCE), Bengaluru. The club brings together passionate students from various engineering disciplines to design, build, and test ultra fuel-efficient vehicles. With a strong focus on sustainability, innovation, and energy efficiency, the team represents RVCE at international competitions such as the Shell Eco-Marathon, where the goal is to achieve the maximum distance on minimal fuel or energy. The club is structured into mechanical, electrical, and management divisions.
events: Powering Performance: Electrical Systems in a Super-Mileage Car; From Screen to Street: Designing & Knowing the Garuda Way; Aerodynamics in Action; From Raw Material to Race-Ready Part

name: Rotaract Club of R.V.C.E.
shortDescription: A service-oriented club focused on community impact, skill-building, and connections through Rotaract's global network.
fullDescription: Rotaract Club of RVCE - where every passion finds a place! From building skills to serving communities, from friendships forged in service to connections reaching Rotaractors around the world, it's the place to learn, grow, connect, and create impact - while loving every moment. Our Flagship events include Fast-Trek, Naivedyam, Blood Donation Camps, Awaaz, Uptown Junk, and Secret Santa, among many more.
events: Full House; Tale in Tandem; Portal to Upside Down; Freshmen Reality

name: SPARK-IUCEE Student Chapter
shortDescription: RVCE's hands-on, student-led IUCEE chapter helping freshers build real skills through workshops, projects, and industry visits.
fullDescription: SPARK: IUCEE-RVCE Student Chapter is RVCE's hands-on, student-led chapter powered by IUCEE where freshers turn curiosity into real skills through workshops, team challenges, industry visits, and national forums. From building projects and exploring cutting-edge companies to meeting experts and peers across India, SPARK helps members learn by doing, grow their network, and sharpen their profile for internships and placements. It's a vibrant community to experiment, lead, and make ideas happen, starting from day one.
events: LinkedIn Launchpad: Level Up Your Career Game!; Industry Insider: Lead, Solve, Triumph!; Tech-tionary: Crack the Code, Guess the Quest!; Gearshift 5.0: Debate the Drive!

name: Women in Cloud CoE Insider Circle
shortDescription: A socio-technical student chapter empowering students in cloud native and automation through mentorship, education, and networking.
fullDescription: The Women in Cloud Insider Circle at RVCE, launched in 2024, is a first-of-its-kind socio-technical team developed as a student chapter under the Women in Cloud Centre of Excellence in India. We're here to empower students in cloud native and automation through mentorship, education, and networking, fostering inclusivity and paving the way for a future with innovations in the tech industry.
events: Network Nexus - Building Bridges to Your Future; Introduction to Cloud & Internships; Vision 2029: From Freshman to Final Year; From Pen to Publish: A Beginner's Guide to Research Writing

name: Team Frequency
shortDescription: A tech innovation club exploring AI, Machine Learning, AR/VR, IoT, Robotics, and Automation to turn bold ideas into real-world impact.
fullDescription: We are the "To Be Engineers" - dreamers, builders, and problem-solvers on a mission to turn bold ideas into real-world impact. At Frequency Club, we don't just talk about the future, we create it - exploring AI, Machine Learning, AR/VR, IoT, Robotics, Automation, and beyond. From tackling everyday challenges to shaping industry breakthroughs, we're where curiosity meets technology, and passion sparks innovation. If you can imagine it, we'll engineer it.
events: Prompt to Product; Human Neural Network; College Mastery; Vision Unlocked - How AI Looks at the World

name: F/6.3 Photography Club
shortDescription: A community of photography enthusiasts capturing moments, telling stories, and exploring the art of photography.
fullDescription: F/6.3 Photography Club is a vibrant community of photography enthusiasts dedicated to capturing moments, telling stories and exploring the art of photography. The club provides a platform for students to enhance their photography skills, engage in creative projects, and participate in events, workshops, and photo walks. The club plays a crucial role in documenting institutional events, promoting campus activities, and encouraging artistic expression through the lens.
events: Introduction to Photography; Photo Editing; Video Editing; Creative Shooting Session

name: ACM RVCE Student Chapter
shortDescription: A vibrant computing community affiliated with the Association for Computing Machinery, fostering innovation, learning, and collaboration.
fullDescription: The ACM RVCE Student Chapter is a vibrant community at RV College of Engineering that fosters innovation, learning, and collaboration in computing. Affiliated with the Association for Computing Machinery, it organizes workshops, hackathons, talks, and competitions, empowering students to explore cutting-edge technologies and develop skills for academic and professional excellence.
events: ACM's Got Talent; Squid Game; Frontend Foundation; CTRL+ Survive - The Final Round

name: Debating Society of RVCE
shortDescription: One of India's oldest and most respected debating societies, built on sharp argumentation, clear reasoning, and fearless expression.
fullDescription: Founded in 2003, RVCE's Debating Society is one of India's oldest and most respected. Our legacy is built on sharp argumentation, clear reasoning and fearless expression. We have twice won the Asian British Parliamentary Debate, reached several finals, and made our presence felt at tournaments hosted by Ramaiah, NLS, NLU and Christ. With an alumni network that spans STEM, venture capital and public policy, including graduates from the Ivy League, we carry forward a tradition of skill and influence that keeps us at the forefront of the debating circuit.
events: The Great Debatsby; Devil's Advocate; Knives Out; Pulp Friction

name: Team Helios Racing
shortDescription: A student-driven club that designs, builds, and races All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs) to compete in BAJA SAE India.
fullDescription: Team Helios Racing is a student-driven club that designs, builds, and races All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs) to compete in BAJA SAE India. With over a decade of innovation, national titles, and international recognition, we are RVCE's only club that takes part in wheel-to-wheel off-road racing. Here, we combine technical knowledge, creativity and teamwork to push limits on unforgiving terrain and experience the thrill of true motorsport.
events: GearUp Garage: Car Building Fundamentals; Accelerate to Innovate: Ideas at Racing Speed; Reaction Grid - Where Milliseconds Matter; The Helios Trials: Survival of the Sharpest

name: Chimera Racing Electric
shortDescription: RVCE's official Formula Student Electric team developing high-efficiency electric race cars driven by innovation and precision.
fullDescription: Chimera Racing Electric is RVCE's official Formula Student Electric team, driven by innovation, precision, and teamwork. Combining advanced engineering, strategic design, and a passion for performance, the team develops high-efficiency electric race cars to compete at the highest level, embodying excellence in technology, sustainability, and competitive spirit.
events: Chimera Corsa Rampage; Chimera Pit Bids; Sketch to Speed

name: Ham Radio Club
shortDescription: RVCE's amateur radio club popularizing Amateur Radio as a hobby while exploring technical innovations in communication.
fullDescription: RVCE Ham Club is the amateur radio club in RVCE. It was inaugurated on 27th August 2019. We aim to popularize Amateur Radio as a hobby among students while exploring technical innovations in the communication domain. RVCE HAM club shall have international collaborations with HAM units across the globe through its activities and aims to have talks with esteemed professionals across the globe through radio communication.
events: Step into Radiowaves with SDR; Crack the CODE - Morse Code Quiz; Antenna Design Made Simple; Test your basics of Basic Electronics

name: Team KRUSHI
shortDescription: An agri-tech engineering team designing and prototyping field-ready solutions to improve farming productivity, safety, and affordability.
fullDescription: Team KRUSHI brings together engineering students to design and prototype field-ready agri-tech solutions that improve productivity, safety, and affordability. Using the TORQUE framework, the club conducts hands-on development, field testing, and farmer collaboration. With two patents to its name, Team KRUSHI welcomes partnerships with industry, researchers, and farming communities to scale and deploy its innovations.
events: Team Krushi Project Showcase; Group Ideathon - Problem to Prototype; Agri-Tech Quiz & Learning Lab; TEDx Talk - How Agriculture Depends on New Technology

name: Team Antariksh
shortDescription: A student space technology club dedicated to advancing aerospace innovation through CanSats and experimental sounding rockets.
fullDescription: Team Antariksh is a student space technology club dedicated to advancing innovation in aerospace engineering. The team designs and builds CanSats and experimental sounding rockets, combining innovation with technical expertise. Each project shows commitment to inspire students to challenge boundaries and invoke curiosity in the field of space technology.
events: Space Quiz and Parachute Test; Payload Ideathon; Build a Heat Shield; Rocket and Payload Auction

name: Team dhRuVa
shortDescription: A space and astronomy club investigating the universe through radio astronomy, telescope building, and data analysis.
fullDescription: We investigate the Universe through various methods, such as listening to radio signals from pulsars, the Sun, and far-off galaxies; constructing telescopes to observe the night sky; and analyzing actual data to uncover hidden narratives in stars and clusters. We engage in stargazing, converse with scientists, grasp the science, and even publish our findings. Whether your interest lies in watching the stars, unraveling cosmic enigmas, or simply connecting with other sky enthusiasts, you will find a welcoming space here.
events: DDA Division - Data-Driven Astronomy: A Primer; Radio Division - Sound of Space; Optical Division - Optics 101; Research Division - Back to the Past

name: TEDxRVCE
shortDescription: An independently organized TED-style event bringing inspiring local speakers and performances to spark ideas worth spreading.
fullDescription: TEDxRVCE is an independently organized TED-style event hosted at RVCE. We bring together inspiring local speakers and vibrant performances to spark meaningful conversations and explore ideas worth spreading. The events are driven by a student-organizing team and creatively tailored to the college community, all while adhering to TED's brand and guidelines, bringing a global TED-like experience to campus and amplifying diverse voices.
events: Networking Mixer; Creative Chaos; Game Jam Social; Reel Challenge

name: Team Astra Robotics
shortDescription: A student-led robotics club designing intelligent, autonomous systems for global competitions and leading STEM outreach.
fullDescription: Team ASTRA Robotics is a student-led club dedicated to advancing robotics innovation. We design intelligent, autonomous systems for global competitions and lead STEM outreach to inspire future innovators. Founded under the IEEE RVCE Chapter, we continue to collaborate with its Robotics and Automation chapter. Our members gain hands-on experience tackling real-world technical, organizational, and engineering challenges in a collaborative yet competitive environment. From autonomous mobility to AI-driven systems and industrial automation, we foster creativity, leadership, and technical excellence.
events: Robotics Software Prototyping Fundamentals; Robotics Hardware Fundamentals; Robotics Software Fundamentals 2; Inside ASTRA Robotics

name: Team evoke
shortDescription: RVCE's Fashion Club, the ultimate hub for style, creativity, and self-expression through runway shows and styling challenges.
fullDescription: The Fashion Club of RVCE is the ultimate hub for style, creativity, and self-expression. From dazzling runway shows to quirky styling challenges, we bring fashion to life on campus. Our events let you explore everything from modeling and choreography to design and styling, no matter your experience level. It's a space to learn, experiment, and shine with a supportive and stylish community.
events: Design Dash; Lights, Camera, Fashion!; Walk the Talk: Runway 101; Step Up: Style in Motion

name: National Service Scheme
shortDescription: RVCE's community service organization with over 200 active volunteers, guided by the motto 'Not Me But You'.
fullDescription: NSS RVCE is a vibrant student organization dedicated to community service and social responsibility. Guided by the motto 'Not Me But You', it has over 200 active volunteers who take part in various activities like marathons, blood donation camps, cleanliness drives, awareness programs, and rural outreach projects. The unit also organizes special events such as village visits, school improvement drives, and cultural parades to promote social welfare and national pride. Through its continuous efforts, NSS RVCE works towards creating a positive impact on society while developing leadership and empathy among students.
events: Paint It Forward; Shout It Out; Act and Solve; Link It for Good

name: CARV Hindi
shortDescription: A Hindi dramatics club exploring acting, scriptwriting, stage performance, and direction through street plays and theatre.
fullDescription: CARV Hindi isn't just a Dramatics club, we are a Storm with a Script. We bring together creative minds to explore acting, scriptwriting, stage performance and direction. Through Street Plays, Theatre, Mono-acts, Mime and much more, we aim to showcase our artistic expression, put forth social issues and channel the chaos we're all born with. Till date we have been to the country's largest fests like at IIT Bombay, Bits Goa, IIT Madras, IIT Kharagpur, IISC and brought back trophies along with stories.
events: Curtains Up: Welcome to the Drama; Aaj, Abhi, Isi Wakt: The Unscripted Stage; Aapka Manch (A Talent Hunt); The Filmy Tickle

name: Ashwa Racing
shortDescription: India's first Formula Student team, driving innovation in combustion and hybrid race car engineering since 2003.
fullDescription: Ashwa Racing, India's first Formula Student team, has been driving innovation since 2003. From building its first prototype in 2005 to competing at FSAE Australasia, FS Germany, and FS Italy, the team has proudly represented India on the global stage. In 2015, Ashwa ventured into hybrid technology, earning a world top-10 rank in its very first attempt. Today, with over 20 years of legacy, the team builds multiple prototypes annually across combustion and hybrid categories, backed by strong industry collaborations and a vision to shape the future of mobility.
events: Racecraft 101; Race Day Rescue; Assembly Sprint; Full Throttle Trivia

name: E CELL
shortDescription: A student-led organization fostering innovation, leadership, and entrepreneurship on campus through workshops, pitches, and talks.
fullDescription: E-Cell is a dynamic, student-led organization that fosters innovation, leadership, and entrepreneurship on campus. Functioning through five verticals - Corporate Partnerships, Events & Operations, Startup & Innovation, Media & Tech, and Marketing & PR - it creates a holistic platform for students to gain hands-on experience. From interactive workshops, pitch competitions, and techno-cultural events to inspiring entrepreneur talks, networking sessions, and collaborative projects, E-Cell empowers members to transform ideas into impact, making it a thriving hub of creativity, real-world learning, and professional excellence.
events: Fund My Failure; ECell Got Latent; Start Up 101; Startup Trivia

name: ALAAP
shortDescription: RVCE's Music Club, a vibrant hub uniting students through music, open mics, masterclasses, and live performances.
fullDescription: Alaap - The Music Club of RVCE is a vibrant hub that has been uniting students through music for decades, fostering a sense of belonging and community on campus. With a rich legacy and numerous success stories, Alaap has been the cradle of emerging bands like Project Mishram and Dastaan, who have gone on to shine on larger stages. The club continues to blossom into a dynamic center of creativity, inspiring artistic expression, nurturing innovation, and cultivating talent.
events: Club Introduction and Open Mic; Masterclasses on Various Topics; Masterclasses on Various Topics; Club Performances

name: CARV English
shortDescription: One of RVCE's premier English-language acting clubs, founded in 2001, with a history of national theatre wins.
fullDescription: CARV English is one of the premier acting clubs in RVCE, was founded in 2001, and continues to have a glorious history of actors and plays since then. We have been winners at premier national fests conducted at NIT Trichy, NIT Surathkal and IIT-Madras, and at various local competitions in Bangalore such as Manipal and NIMHANS. We conduct two flagship events: Coliseum and Productions, where original plays go up on stage, open to the public. CARV English is not just an acting club, its a place where you truly find yourself as you navigate through 4 years of engineering.
events: Act-ivites; IEM (Not the Dept.) - Improv, Expressions and Mime; Writer's Purgatory; The Big Backstage Story

name: Studio Zero
shortDescription: RVCE's filmmaking club, a passionate community of movie enthusiasts bringing stories to life through collaborative filmmaking.
fullDescription: Welcome to STUDIO ZERO, RVCE's filmmaking club! We're a passionate community of movie enthusiasts who bring stories to life through collaborative filmmaking. Whether you're interested in acting, directing, cinematography, editing, music composition, or any other aspect of film production, there's a place for you here.
events: From Lens to Cut; 1-Minute Ad Film Challenge; Through My Lens Vlog Challenge; Cinephile Circle

name: RAAG
shortDescription: The Youth Club of RVCE, adding energy and creativity to campus life through events like 8th Mile and Night Cricket.
fullDescription: RAAG, the youth club of RVCE, adds energy and creativity to campus life. Through its five verticals and events like 8th Mile, Matrubhasha Divas, and Night Cricket, it fosters leadership, collaboration, and the true spirit of youth. It is a platform for students to explore talents, innovate, and create unforgettable experiences. With unity and diversity at its core, RAAG truly reflects the vibrant spirit of RVCE.
events: Ice Breaker Games - Laugh. Connect. Repeat.; Endless Juggle - Don't Drop It!; Ask Seniors Anything - No Filter All Answers; RAAG Presents Open Mic - Your Stage. Your Vibe.
